MINUTES
  MALIBU CITY COUNCIL
  SPECIAL MEETING
  DECEMBER 16, 2024
  MALIBU WEST BEACH CLUB
  2:00 P.M.

MEETING CALL TO ORDER

  Mayor Stewart called the meeting to order at 2:00 pm.

ROLL CALL

  The following persons were recorded in attendance by the Recording Secretary:

  PRESENT: Mayor Doug Stewart; Mayor Pro Tern Marianne Riggins;  and
  Councilmembers Haylynn Conrad, Bruce Silverstein and Steve Uhring.

  ALSO PRESENT: Trevor Rusin, Interim City Attorney; Joseph Toney, Assistant City
  Manager; Kelsey Pettijohn, City Clerk; Kristin Riesgo, Community Services Director;
  Yolanda Bundy, Environmental Sustainability Director; Susan Duenas, Public Safety
  Director; Rob DuBouX, Public Works Director; Christina Munoz, Deputy City Clerk; Jason
  Lawrence, Deputy City Clerk; Tracey Rossine, EnVironmental Programs Manager; and
  Travis Hart, Deputy Public Works Director

REPORT ON POSTING OF AGENDA

  City Clerk Pettijohn reported that the agenda for the meeting was properly posted on
  December 15, 2024.

APPROVAL OF AGENDA

MOTION  Councilmember Uhring moved, and Mayor Pro Tem Riggins seconded a motion t0
  approve the agenda. The motion carried unanimously.

PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE

  Chris Frost led the Pledge of Allegiance.

ITEM 1  NEW BUSINESS

  A.  Resolution Ratifying the Director of Emergency Services’ Proclamation of the
  Existence of a Local Emergency and Declaring the Same
  Recommended Action: l) Adopt Resolution No. 24-64, confirming existence of a
  local emergency, and ratifying the proclamation of local emergency by the Acting
  Director of Emergency Services; and 2) Approve and authorize the submittal of a
  letter requesting recovery assistance from the State of California in accordance with
  the California Disaster Assistance Act.

  Assistant City Manager Toney presented the staff report.
   Malibu City Council
  Minutes of December 16, 2024
  Page 2 of 3

  Mayor Stewart opened the floor to public comment. As there were no speakers
  present, Mayor Stewart returned the matter to the table for discussion.

  The Council discussed the item.

  MOTION  Mayor Pro Tem Riggins moved, and Councilmember Silverstein seconded a
  motion to: 1) adopt Resolution No. 24—64, confirming existence of a local
  emergency, and ratifying the proclamation of local emergency by the Acting
  Director of Emergency Services; and 2) approve and authorize the submittal of a
  letter requesting recovery assistance from the State of Califomia in accordance with
  the Califomia Disaster Assistance Act. The motion carried unanimously.

  B.  Resolution Designating Additional Successors to the Position of Director of
  Emergency Services
  Recommended Action: Adopt Resolution No. 24-,65 approving the Acting
  Director of Emergency Services designation that in the event the acting director of
  emergency services is unavailable, he or she may designate any city department
  head to serve in this role should the current designated successors (the Assistant
  City Manager, Deputy City Manager, and Public Safety Director) be unavailable.
